name: da_test_scenarios_sprint2
description: Independently DA-authored eval data from Laplace_Data Analyst.pdf, converted into AgentGate's ActionRequest schema: 15 fully-specified TC-* scenarios (Sprint 2 'Finalize Test Scenarios'), 19 net-new RSV-*/PROD-*/DATA-* scenarios from the Sprint 4 26-scenario expected-decision matrix (the other 7 - RSV-04/05/06/08, PROD-03/04/05 - are the same underlying action+decision as an existing TC-* case and were skipped as duplicates, not re-added), and 18 DET-* targeted detector test cases (positive/negative/edge per high-risk category). This is the first eval data in the repo NOT authored by whoever wrote the detectors - closes the 'DS grading its own homework' gap flagged in eval_set.json.
_conversion_note: The source document uses its own ad-hoc ActionRequest-like JSON shape (query_filter, affected_items, recipient, etc.) rather than AgentGate's real schema. Each case below is a best-effort mapping into real ActionRequest fields, preserving the DA's original payload facts (amounts, counts, recipients) in payload_summary/content_context. action_type is mapped to AgentGate's actual action vocabulary since the DA's own action_type strings (BULK_MODIFY, EXTERNAL_SEND, etc.) aren't part of it. Expected decisions are the DA's, unmodified - where AgentGate's real output disagrees, that's a genuine finding, not a data error to be quietly fixed here. Several DET-* edge cases describe behavior AgentGate does not implement (session-level approval carry-over, cumulative risk tracking, Base64 secret decoding) - those are expected to fail and are reported as backlog, not bugs in this file.
